system.description:
When a [Melee Attack] with this weapon hits a target with [Weakness (Flame, Undead, Nature)], you may use "Heal" at the end of that Main Process. A silver mace with a flange shaped like burning purifying flame. It appears unremarkable at first glance, but if it defeats a monster with a weakness, it greatly reduces the recast time of healing spells. Because of this rare effect, even high-level healers often use it as a sub weapon.

Fire Fairy's Core Material[Core Material](680G)+Spiky Club(730G)+Holy Water(Advanced)(250G)×3+[Magic Catalyst 20](370G)×3+Crafting Cost(1230G)
